程序包 org.bukkit.event.player

类 AsyncPlayerChatEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
org.bukkit.event.player.AsyncPlayerChatEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class AsyncPlayerChatEvent extends PlayerEvent implements Cancellable
This event will sometimes fire synchronously, depending on how it was triggered. 此事件有时会同步触发，取决于它的触发方式。

The constructor provides a boolean to indicate if the event was fired synchronously or asynchronously. When asynchronous, this event can be called from any thread, sans the main thread, and has limited access to the API. 构造方法提供了一个布尔值来指示该事件是同步还是异步触发的。异步时，此事件可以从除主线程外的任何线程调用，且对 API 的访问受限。

If a player is the direct cause of this event by an incoming packet, this event will be asynchronous. If a plugin triggers this event by compelling a player to chat, this event will be synchronous. 如果玩家通过传入的数据包直接引发此事件，该事件将是异步的。如果插件通过驱使玩家发言来触发此事件，则该事件是同步的。

Care should be taken to check Event.isAsynchronous() and treat the event appropriately. 应注意检查 Event.isAsynchronous() 并相应地处理该事件。

    • getRecipients

      public Set<Player> getRecipients()
      Gets a set of recipients that this chat message will be displayed to. 获取将向其显示此聊天消息的接收者集合。

      The set returned is not guaranteed to be mutable and may auto-populate on access. Any listener accessing the returned set should be aware that it may reduce performance for a lazy set implementation. 返回的集合不保证可变，且可能在访问时自动填充。任何访问返回集合的监听器都应注意，对于惰性集合实现，这可能降低性能。

      Listeners should be aware that modifying the list may throw UnsupportedOperationException if the event caller provides an unmodifiable set. 监听器应注意，如果事件调用者提供的是不可修改的集合，修改该列表可能抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

      返回:
      All Players who will see this chat message 将看到此聊天消息的所有玩家
